changelog.notes: 1.0.0 First version: log, history, insights, encrypted two-phone sync, PDF export, backups, Supplement area, remembered medicines and supplements, Log this again.
1.0.1 Description is optional when an entry has a medicine or supplement, a temperature or notes.

1.1.0 Blood test area: results with units and normal ranges from the report, low/high flags, remembered ranges, trend charts in Insights, iron supplement counts between tests, blood test table and charts in the PDF.

1.2.0 Overnight sleep: Sleep entries logged in the evening default to the time they went to sleep and in the morning to the wake-up time; nights are paired into hours slept with averages, a 14-night chart with the Australian guideline band, night wakings, a short-night pattern, a sleep table in the PDF, and a sleep guideline setting.
1.2.1 One-tap "Log a night wake-up now" under Sleep (3–5 min, current time, undo). Night wake-ups are a sleep type with minutes awake, taken off the night total.
1.2.2 Concern level is optional for every entry; tap the chosen level again to clear it.

1.3.0 Supplements and medicines can list what's in them (ingredient and strength), saved with the product so the remembered button fills them in; iron inside a product counts towards the ferritin iron note; shown in History, search, PDF and text export.
